'Ghost: Yoru no Hate' Reveals Main Cast Pair, Third Teaser Trailer
The official website for the Ghost: Yoru no Hate original anime movie revealed the main cast and a third teaser trailer on Friday. The movie is scheduled to open in Japanese theaters on February 11, 2027. Actors Mayu Hotta (Blue Thermal) and Issei Takahashi (Mimi wo Sumaseba) are starring as Nike and Masu, respectively. New 'Ghost in the Shell' TV Anime Announces Additional Cast Pair
The official website for the new Koukaku Kidoutai (The Ghost in the Shell) television anime announced an additional pair of cast on Thursday. The new TV anime premiered on Tuesday at 11:00 p.m. on Kansai TV and Fuji TV affiliates. Voice actresses Aya Hisakawa (Dragon Ball Daima) and Nina Kumagaya (Yowamushi Pedal) are joining the cast as Annapuna and Unipuma, respectively. The official website for the television anime adaptation of Ryou Ariyama's Romelia Senki (Romelia War Chronicle) light novel revealed additional cast and first promotional video on Friday.
